timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1550–1600 KRW per USD (current); expected to weaken to 1500 within 3 months

WHY: The won is currently weak (high KRW per USD), making your $2,000 monthly conversion expensive. Multiple analysts, including Citi, forecast the won will strengthen to around 1500 KRW/USD within 3 months as semiconductor exports stabilize, meaning you would need fewer won to buy the same dollars later.

TIP: If possible, consider delaying or scaling back conversions this month and waiting 2–3 months for the won to strengthen, which would reduce your monthly won cost significantly.
